49c7afa8: Set DG=DV, Y=DE(DQ), X=DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute that code block. Go to label RP.

2966c7cf: If DG contains 'P' and the global node ^(X_"0)") is defined, set X to the value at ^(0),U,2. Go to RP if ^(Y,0) is undefined. Otherwise, set Y=$P(^(0),U), X=$P(^DD(X,.01,0),U,3), DG=$P(^(0),U,2). Go to label R.

d1393ff8: If DG contains 'V' and Y is numeric and $P(Y,";",2) contains '(' and the global node @(U_$P(Y,";",2)_"0)") is defined, set X to value at ^(0),U,2. Go to RP if ^(+Y,0) is undefined. Otherwise, set Y=$P(^(0),U). If ^DD(+X,.01,0) is defined, set DG=$P(^(0),U,2), X=$P(^(0),U,3). Go to label R.
